name: lingo-pane
description: Learn a language live in your terminal: a lesson pane, micro-lessons while Claude works, swappable strategies.

targetLanguage.title: Target language
targetLanguage.description: The language you are learning (for example: English, Ukrainian, French).

nativeLanguage.title: Native language
nativeLanguage.description: The language explanations are written in.

openPaneWhileWaiting.title: Open the lesson pane while Claude works
openPaneWhileWaiting.description: Off by default: only a one-line micro-lesson shows in the spinner. When on, the mod also tries to open the lesson pane after a short wait (it needs a wide terminal, otherwise a button offers it).
